definitions.ask: Should the recovery agent land a rustfmt-only fix to sase-core so its master CI turns green again?
definitions.why: core CI is red on formatting alone since 73ec04a02e, blocking the core cut 3 epics wait on

choices.label: Land the formatting-only fix and record it on sase-1pj.6.1; the daily core cut can publish again
Only note it on sase-1pj.6.1; release-chain waits stay blocked until that epic fixes it

definitions.ask: Should gc-fix (sase-1nf.14) be relaunched instead of closed as superseded?
definitions.why: sase-1f3 and sase-1nc already own the remaining capture and producer work

Close sase-1nf.14 as superseded by ready tasks sase-1f3 and sase-1nc; sase-1nf can land
